source: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
reference: "Wahini kita baisian tikus baumur 4 bulan nang sudah kada diabetes nang mana asalnya masih diabetes," jar inya.
hypothesis: "Kami wayahini baisi tikus umur 4 bulan nang kada manjangkiti diabetes nang dulunya manjangkiti diabetes", tambahnya.

source: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, paropesor ubat-ubatan di Universitas Dalhousie nang di Halifax, Nova Scotia wan jua kapala bagian klinis wan alamiah dari Parkumpulan Diabetes Urang Kanada mamadahi panalitian ini nih masih pamulaannya haja.
hypothesis: Dr. Ehud Ur, profesor kedokteran di Universitas Dalhousie di Halifax, Nova Scotia wan ketua divisi klinis wan ilmiah Asosiasi Diabetes Kanada, mamparingati bahwa penelitian masih dalam tahap awal.

source: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
reference: Nangkaya jar babarapa ahli, sidin a’asaan napakah diabetes ini nih kawa ampih, maingat kalo tamuan-tamuan ngini nang kadada bakaitan wan urang-urang nang sudah maharit diabetes janis 1.
hypothesis: Nang kaya ahli-ahli lain, inya ragu-ragu apakah diabetes kawa diobati, mancatat bahwa temuan-temuan ini kada ba'aplikasi gasan urang-urang nang sudah baisi diabetes Tipe 1.

source: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
reference: Pas hari Senin, Sara Darius, sekretaris tatap Kumite Panghargaan Literasi di Akademi Swedia, sacara umum mahabarakan liwat acara radiunya Radiu Sveriges di Swedia, bubuhan angguta kumite kadada nang kawa mahubungi Bob Dylan langsung gasan mamadahi bahuwa inya mamanangakan Hadiah Panghargaan Literasi Tahun 2016, jadi sia-sia haja.
hypothesis: Senin, Sara Danius, sekretaris permanen Komite Nobel gasan Sastra di Akademi Swedia, secara publik manyataakan selama program radio di Sveriges Radio di Swedia bahwa komite, kada kawa langsung mandapatakan Bob Dylan tentang mandapatkan Hadiah Nobel dalam Sastra 2016, sudah maninggalakan usahanya gasan mandapatkannya.

source: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
reference: Jar Danius, "Wahini, kami lagi kadada beapa-apa. Aku sudah mahubungi wan mangirimi surat elektrunik ka kulaburator nang parak wan inya imbah tu kami manarima balasannya nang ramah bangat. Jadi, gasan wahini cukup haja dulu."
hypothesis: Danius manjawab, "Kini kami kada lagi maulah apa-apa. Aku sudah mangiyau wan mangirim suril ka kolaborator parak sidin wan manarima jawaban nang ramah banar.

source: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.

source: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.

source: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.

source: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.

source: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.

source: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
reference: Kami satuju wan parnyataan USOC bahuwa kapantingan klub wan atlit kita, wan cabang ulahraga buhannya, mungkin dilayani labih baik lagi kaya malangkah maju wan parubahan nang ba’arti dalam kapangurusan kita daripada mandesertifikasiakan.

source: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.

source: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
reference: Pasenaman Amerika Serikat wan USOC baisi tujuan nang sama — maulah cabang ulahraga, wan cabang ulahraga lainya jua, sa’aman mungkin hagan buhan atlit dalam manyasah mimpinya di lingkungan nang aman, pusitip, wan mandukung.

source: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
reference: Salawas tahun 1960-an, Brzekzinski bagawi gasan John F. Kennedy sabagai panasihatnya imbah tu administrasi Lyndon B. Johnson.

source: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.

source: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.

source: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
reference: Ini nih kada hanya gasan mamastiakan bahuwa paling kada babarapa dinosaurus bisi bulu, teorinya sudah manyabar luas, tapi rincian fusil mamadahakan kada, nangkaya warna wan susunan tiga dimensinya.
hypothesis: Hal ini kada hanya mangkonfirmasi bahwa sekurang-kurangnya babarapa dinosaurus baisi bulu, teori nang sudah banyak dipakai, tapi jua mangiyaakan rincian nang umumnya kada kawa dihasilakan oleh fosil, kaya warna wan susunan tiga dimensi.

source: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
reference: Jar bubuhan panaliti bulu binatang ini nih bawarna cuklat kastanye pucat di atas atawa karotenoid di bagian bawah.
hypothesis: Ilmuwan manurutakan bahwa bulu binatang ini warna coklat di atasnya lawan bagian bawahnya warna pucat atawa karotenoid.

source: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
reference: Panamuannya jua mananggung wawasan tantang epolusi bulu di burung.
hypothesis: Penemuan jua memberikan wawasan tentang evolusi bulu pada burung.

source: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
reference: Sabab bulu dinosaurus kada bisi purus pusat nang marangkat sampurna, nang ngarannya rachis, tapi baciri bulu lain — duri wan barbule — bubuhan panaliti manyimpulakan rachis itu nangkaya rangkatan epolusi lanjutan matan ciri-ciri lain ngini.
hypothesis: Karena bulu dinosaurus kada baisi batang nang berkembang baik, nang disambat rachis, tapi baisi ciri-ciri lainnya dari bulu  barbs dan barbules  para peneliti menyimpulkan bahwa rachis kemungkinan adalah perkembangan evolusioner nang lebih akhir daripada fitur-fitur lainnya.

source: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
reference: Susunan bulu-bulu ngini mamadahiakan kalu ngini kada gasan tarabang tapi gasan ma’atur suhu atawa panampilan. Bubuhan panaliti bapikiran bahuwa biar ngini nih buntut dinosaurus anum, sampelnya manampaiakan bulu dewasa wan lainan bulu bawah.
hypothesis: Struktur bulu manunjukakan bahwa buhannya kada dipakai dalam panambangan tapi gasan pangaturan suhu atawa pamersi. Para panaliti manunjukakan bahwa, walaupun ini adalah ekor dinosaurus nang anum, sampel manunjukakan buluan dewasa wan kada anak-anak.

source: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.

source: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.

source: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
reference: Luminositas wan putaran dipakai baimbaian gasan manantuakan angka bintang Rossby, nang baraitan lawan aliran plasma.
hypothesis: Luminositas wan rotasi dipakai basamaan gasan manantuakan angka Rossby bintang, nang bahubungan lawan aliran plasma.

source: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
reference: Magin halus angka Rossby, magin sadikit jua pargarakan bintang wan hubungan pambalikan magnet.
hypothesis: Semakin halus bilangan Rossby, semakin kada aktif bintang dalam hal pembalikan magnet.

source: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.

source: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.

source: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today.

source: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
reference: Lapuran ngini mangaritik karas handak di satiap bantuk kabijakan Eksekutip tarhadap Irak wan lapuran ngini manggasak sabuting parubahan langkah capat.
hypothesis: Laporan ini sangat kritis terhadap hampir setiap aspek kebijakan saat ini dari Eksekutif terhadap Irak dan mendorong perubahan arah segera.

source: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
reference: Papadahan pamulaan matan 78 papadahannya ngitu kalo sabuting inisiatip diplumatik hanyar saharusnya diambil sabalum pahabisan tahun ini gasan ma’amanakan parbatasan Irak malawan campur tangan musuh wan jua mambangun pulang raitan diplumatik wan nagara tatangganya.
hypothesis: Nang pertama di antara 78 rekomendasi adalah bahwa inisiatif diplomatik hanyar harus diambil sebelum akhir tahun ini gasan mengamankan perbatasan Irak lawan campur tangan nang kada ramah wan gasan meulah hubungan diplomatik lawan negara-negara tetangganya.

source: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
reference: Angguta senat nang wahini wan jua Ibu Negara Argentina Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner mahabarakan pancalunan presiden sidin samalam di La Plata, kota nang bajarak 50 kilumitir (31 mil) matan Buenos Aires.
hypothesis: Senator wan Ibu Negara Argentina Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner manyambat diri gasan jadi presiden malam tadi di La Plata, kota nang bajarak 50 kilometer dari Buenos Aires.

source: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
reference: Nyunyah Kirchner mahabarakan tujuan sidin jadi presiden di Teater Argentina, wadah nang sama lawan pas sidin bakampanye bahari di tahun 2005 gasan mancalun jadi angguta senat parwakilan prupinsi Buenos Aires.
hypothesis: Bu Kirchner manyambat niatnya gasan bakandidasi gasan jadi presiden di Teater Argentina, lokasi nang sama nang dipakai sidin gasan mamulai kampanye 2005 gasan Senat sabagai anggota delegasi provinsi Buenos Aires.

source: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
reference: Hualan dipicu ulih parsalisihan pangaluaran gasan balanja wan parbaikan imbah kana Badai Katrina; nang mana babarapa urang-urang kauangan nang tuha manyambat ini tu "Parjanjian New Orleans Bush"
hypothesis: Perdebatan ini diulah oleh kontroversi tentang belanja gasan bantuan wan rekonstruksi pas Hurricane Katrina; nang beberapa konservatif fiskal dengan lucu melabel "New Orleans Deal Bush".

source: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
reference: Karitik liberal sual usaha pambangunan ulang nang bapokus ka pambarian kuntrak pambangunan ulang gasan bubuhan urang dalam Washington.
hypothesis: Kritik liberal gasan upaya rekonstruksi sudah fokus pada pemberian kontrak rekonstruksi gasan orang dalam Washington nang dianggap.

source: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
reference: Labih ampat juta urang tulakan ka Roma gasan mandatangi pamakaman.
hypothesis: Lebih dari ampat juta urang datang ka Roma gasan hadir di parjamuan.

source: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
reference: Jumlah urang nang datang banyak banar sampai urang kada cagaran kawa masuk ka dalam pamakaman di St. Peter’s Square.
hypothesis: Jumlah urang nang hadir sangat ganal sahingga kada mungkin gasan sabarataan gasan masuk ka parjamuan di Lapangan St. Peter.

source: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
reference: Babarapa tipi balayar ganal dipasang dibamacam-macam wadah supaya urang kawa maliat upacaranya.
hypothesis: Babarapa layar televisi ganal ditampaiakan di bamacam-macam wadah di Roma gasan mamungkinakan urang-urang manonton upacara.

source: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
reference: Di babarapa kota di Italia wan balahan dunia nang lain, tarutama di Pulandia, diulah pangaturan nang sama, diliati urang dalam jumlah nang banyak banar.
hypothesis: Di banyak kota lain di Italia wan di dunia, khususnya di Polandia, ada acara nang sama, nang ditonton ulih banyak urang.

source: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
reference: Sejarawan mangaritik kabijakan-kabijakan FBI tadahulu nang bapokus ka kasus-kasus nang nyaman digawi, hususnya kasus maling mubil, bamaksud gasan maningkatakan angka kabarhasilan.
hypothesis: Sejarawan mengkritik kebijakan FBI masa lalu gasan memfokuskan sumber daya pada kasus nang mudah diatasi, khususnya kasus mobil curian, dengan tujuan meningkatkan tingkat keberhasilan agensi.

source: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
reference: Kungris mulai mangumpulakan insiatip kacarutan di tahun 2005 wan husus FBI harus mamokusakan 10 agennya gasan pornograpi dewasa.
hypothesis: Kongres mulai mendanai inisiatif obsesi pada tahun fiskal 2005 wan manantuakan bahwa FBI harus manyadiaakan 10 agen gasan pornografi dewasa.

source: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
reference: Robin Uthappa mancitak skor inning paningginya, 70 kali run baya pakai 41 bal wan manapak 11 kali angka ampat wan 2 kali angka anam.
hypothesis: Robin Uthappa mancapai skor tertinggi dalam sabuting innings, 70 run dalam 41 bola haja lawan manembak 11 fours wan 2 sixes.

source: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
reference: Pamain tangah manyuruh panapak, Sachin Tendulkar wan Rahul Dravid, bamain baik wan maulah ratusan run.
hypothesis: Pembalap urutan tengah, Sachin Tendulkar wan Rahul Dravid, baparan baik wan maulah pakambangan saratus.

source: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
reference: Tapi, imbah kahilangan kapten panjaga gawang India mancitak 36 kali run kahilangan 7 ja gasan manuntungakan inning.
hypothesis: Tapi, imbah kalah lawan kapten, India hanya mancapai 36 lawan 7 wicket gasan manutup innings.

source: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
reference: Presiden Amerika Serikat George W. Bush sampai di Singapura tanggal 16 November pagi, mamulai tur Asianya samingguan.
hypothesis: Presiden Amerika Serikat George W. Bush sampai di Singapura pada pagi tanggal 16 November, mulai tur Asia nang lawasnya saminggu.

source: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
reference: Sidin disambut ulih Pawakilan Pardana Mantri Wong Kan Seng wan bapapanderan parihal pardagangan jua tiruris lawan Pardana Mantri Singapura Lee Hsien Loong.
hypothesis: Sidin disambut oleh Wakil Perdana Menteri Singapura Wong Kan Seng wan bahadapan masalah perdagangan wan terorisme lawan Perdana Menteri Singapura Lee Hsien Loong.

source: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
reference: Imbah samingguan mahilang di tangah-tangah pamilihan, Bush mamadahi ka umum sual parluasan pardagangan ka Asia.
hypothesis: Imbah saminggu kalah di pilkada paruh waktu, Bush manyambat ka hadirin tentang ekspansi pardagangan di Asia.

source: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
reference: Pardana Mantri Stephen Harper sudah manyatujui gasan mangirim UU Udara Barasih ka sabarataan anggota komite partai gasan dipariksa ba’asa, sabalum pambacaan kadua, imbah partamuan salawas 25 menit hari Salasa lawan pamimpin NDP Jack Layton di PMO.
hypothesis: Perdana Menteri Stephen Harper sudah setuju gasan mangirim 'Act Air Clean' pemerintah ke panitia partai-partai gasan diulas, sebelum pembacaan kedua, imbah pertemuan 25 menit Selasa lawan pemimpin NDP Jack Layton di PMO.

source: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
reference: Layton sudah mancatu parubahan gasan rancangan undang-undang lingkungannya kunserpatif pas batamuan lawan Pardana Mantri, mancatu supaya "malihat wan manuntungakan ba’asa" rancangan undang-undang lingkungan partai Kunserpatif.
hypothesis: Layton ma'inta parubahan ka undang-undang lingkungan konservatif wayah pertemuan lawan PM, ma'inta "penulisan ulang nang tuntung wan lengkap" dari undang-undang lingkungan konservatif.

source: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
reference: Mulai ngitu Pamarintahan Federal ma’ambil alih pandanaan rumah sakit Mersey di Devonport, Tasmania, pamarintahan nagara wan babarapa angguta parlemen federal sudah mangaritik pargarakan ngini sabagai aksi pamulaan di pamilihan federal nang dilaksana’akan di bulan Nopember.
hypothesis: Sejak pemerintah federal masuk gasan mengambil alih pendanaan rumah sakit Mersey di Devonport, Tasmania, pemerintah negara bagian wan beberapa anggota parlemen federal mengkritik tindakan ini sebagai preludi ke pemilu federal nang akan disambat pada November.

source: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
reference: Tapi, Pardana Mantri John Howard sudah manyambat sikap nitu babaya gasan ma’amanakan pasilitas rumah sakit biar kada manurun kualitasnya ulih pamarintahan Tasmania, pambarian dana tambahan sabanyak 45 juta dular Australia.
hypothesis: Tapi Perdana Menteri John Howard manyambat tindakan itu hanya gasan melindungi fasilitas rumah sakit dari direduksi oleh pemerintah Tasmania, dalam memberikan tambahan AUD$45 juta.

source: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.
reference: Badasarakan habar paling hanyar, pangamatan parmukaan laut manunjukakan tsunami maningkat. Ada babarapa aktipitas tsunami nang tarekam di parak Pago Pago wan Niue.
hypothesis: Menurut buletin terbaru, pengukuran permukaan laut menunjuk akan adanya tsunami.

source: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
reference: Kadada karusakan atawa luka sarius nang dihabarakan di Tonga, tapi kahilangan daya samantara waktu nang mangalihakan pihak barwenang Tonga gasan manarima paringatan tsunami ulih PTWC.
hypothesis: Kadada karusakan ganal atawa luka-luka nang dilaporkan di Tonga, tapi kakuatan tahalang samantara, nang dilaporkan mancegah otoritas Tonga manarima peringatan tsunami nang dikeluarkan oleh PTWC.

source: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
reference: Ampat belas sakulahan di Hawaii nang baandak atawa baparakan lawan garis pantai sabarataannya pas hari Arba ditutup sampai habar paringatan dicabut.
hypothesis: Ampat belas sekolah di Hawaii nang baandak di atawa parak garis pantai ditutup samunyaan Rabu walaupun paringatan sudah dihapus.

source: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
reference: Presiden Amerika Serikat George W. Bush manyambut baik habar ngitu.
hypothesis: Presiden Amerika Serikat George W. Bush menyambut pengumuman itu.

source: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
reference: Jubir Bush Gordon Johndroe manyambat janji Korea Utara "sabuah langkah ganal gasan tujuan pancapaian dinuklirisasi di samananjung Korea."
hypothesis: "Perancer Bush Gordon Johndroe mangarani janji Korea Utara "sabuting langkah ganal gasan mencapai tujuan denuklirisasi semenanjung Korea nang kawa diverifikasi".

source: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
reference: Badai kasapuluh musim Badai Angin Ribut Atlantik, Badai Subtrupis Jerry, ada di Samudera Atlantik hari ni.
hypothesis: Badai nang disambat ka-sepuluh musim Badai Atlantik, Badai Subtropis Jerry, tabantuk di Samudra Atlantik hari ini.

source: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
reference: Pusat Badai Angin Ribut Nasiunal (NHC) manyambat bahuwa pada ka’adaan wahini Jerry kadada manimbulakan ancaman ka daratan.
hypothesis: Pusat Badai Nasional (NHC) manyambat bahwa pada titik ini Jerry kada mambari ancaman gasan daratan.

source: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
reference: Parsatuan Insinyur Amerika Serikat manangguhi bahuwa curah hujan 6 inci kawa manambus tanggul nang sudah rusak sabalumnya.
hypothesis: Korps Insinyur AS manaksir bahwa hujan 6 inci kawa malapas bendungan nang sebelumnya rusak.

source: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
reference: Ninth Ward, nang banjirnya satinggi 20 kaki salawas Badai Angin Ribut Katrina, wahini katinggian banyunya sapinggang nang mana tanggul nang parak situ sudah limpuar.
hypothesis: Ward Kasampaian, nang manamuakan banjir nang tinggi sampai 20 kaki pas Badai Katrina, wayah ini dalam banyu nang tinggi sampai pinggang karena bendungan di paraknya sudah dihabisi.

source: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
reference: Banyunya limpas pada tanggul saluas 100 kaki.
hypothesis: Air manimbulakan di atas bendungan dalam bagian nang lebarnya 30 kaki.

source: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
reference: Admin Umum Adam Cuerden manunjukakan kasarekannya tarhadap panghapusan pas inya bapander lawan Wikinews bulan kamarian.
hypothesis: Pangurus Commons Adam Cuerden manyambat kacewaannya lawan pambusakan nangitu wayah sidin bapandir lawan Wikinews bulan lalu.

source: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
reference: "Inya [Wales] tuh badusta dah matan pamulaan wan kami. Partama, bapiragah ini nih gasan alasan nang rasmi. Kadua, bapura-pura mandangarakan apa jar kami, sampai ka panghapusan."
hypothesis: "Sudah dari awal, sidin [Wales] sudah baboh, partama, dengan baperan kaya ini gasan alasan hukum, kadua, lawan bapikir sidin mandangar kami, sampai mahapus gambar sidin".

source: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
reference: Kajingkilan masyarakat mangarah ka usaha wayah ini gasan manyusun kabijakan parihal seksual gasan situs nang mawadahi jutaan media.
hypothesis: Keributan masyarakat manuntun upaya gasan manulis kebijakan tentang konten seksual gasan situs nang mana jutaan media dilisensikan.

source: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
reference: Gawiannya sabagian ganal barupa tiuritis, tapi prugramnya ditulis maulah tiruan pangamatan galaksi Sagitarius.
hypothesis: Gawian nang digawi adalah teoritis, tapi program itu ditulis gasan mensimulasikan pengamatan nang digawi dari galaksi Sagitarius.

source: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
reference: Epek nang dicari tim bisa ja disababakan ulih pasang surut antara materi kadap galaksi wan materi kadap Bimasakti.
hypothesis: Efek nang dicari tim akan disababakan oleh gaya pasang antara materi gelap galaksi wan materi gelap Bima Sakti.

source: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
reference: Nangkaya bulan manjuhut bumi, nang manyababakan pasang surut, kaya itu jua Bimasakti mamakai kakuatan ka galaksi Sagitarius.
hypothesis: Sama kaya bulan manarik bumi, manyababakan pasang surut, jadi Bima Sakti jua manarik galaksi Sagitarius.

source: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
reference: Buhan panaliti kawa manyimpulakan materi kadap mamangaruhi materi kadap lainnya pakai cara nang sama.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan mampu menyimpulkan bahwa materi gelap mempengaruhi materi gelap lainnya dengan cara yang sama seperti materi biasa.

source: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
reference: Tiuri ngini manyambat bahuwa kabanyakan materi kadap di sakitar galaksi barada di sakitar galaksi dalam bantuk bulatan cahaya, wan taulah matan partikel-partikel halus.
hypothesis: Teori ini mengatakan bahwa kebanyakan materi gelap di sekitar galaksi terletak di sekitar galaksi dalam semacam halo, dan terbuat dari banyak partikel kecil.

source: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
reference: Habar tipi manampaiakan asap putih kaluar matan pabrik.
hypothesis: Laporan televisi manunjukakan asap putih nang mancarang matan pabrik.

source: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
reference: Patugas satampat mahinggur ka warga nang barada di sakitaran pabrik supaya di rumah haja, kada manyalai AC wan kada nginum banyu ledeng.
hypothesis: Otoritas lokal maingatakan panduduk di parak pabrik gasan tatap di dalam rumah, mamatikan AC wan kada minum banyu banyu.

source: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
reference: Badasarakan lembaga nuklir japang, bahan radiuaktip caesium wan iodine sudah dikatahui di daerah pabrik.
hypothesis: Manurut agénsi nuklir Jepang, cesium wan yodium radioaktif hudah diidentifikasi di pabrik.

source: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
reference: Patugas nang barwenang manduga bahuwa ada manunjukakan kabucuran panampung nang mamuat uranium.
hypothesis: Otoritas bepikir bahwa ini manunjukakan bahwa wadah nang mangandung bahan bakar uranium di situs mungkin hudah pecah wan macuak.

source: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
reference: Dr. Tony Moll manamuakan Tuberkolosis (XDR-TB) nang taguh lawan ubat di Afrika Salatan daerah KwaZulu-Natal.
hypothesis: Dr. Tony Moll manamuakan Tuberkulosis nang sangat resisten lawan obat (XDR-TB) di wilayah Afrika Selatan KwaZulu-Natal.

source: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
reference: Dalam sabuah wawancara, sidin manyambat pariasi hanyar ini "liwar mambahayakan wan mahawatirakan sabab liwar patal."
hypothesis: "Dalam wawancara, inya manyambat bahwa varian hanyar ngitu ""sangat manyusahkan wan mamparingati karena tingkat kematian nang sangat tinggi".""

source: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
reference: Babarapa pasien mungkin sudah manyebarakan pirusnya di rumah sakit, Dr. Moll bapikir, wan paling kada ada dua patugas kasehatan.
hypothesis: Dr. Moll bapikir, babarapa pasien mungkin sudah manjangkiti virus di rumah sakit, dan sakurang-kurangnya dua adalah pekerja kesehatan rumah sakit.

source: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
reference: Dalam satahunan, urang nang tatular kawa manularakan ka 10 sampai 15 urang dalam jarak nang parak.
hypothesis: Dalam waktu sa tahun, urang nang manular akan virus kawa manularakan 10 sampai 15 urang nang parak lawan inya.

source: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
reference: Tapi, parsentasi XDR-TB di saluruh kalumpuk urang nang ada tuberkolosis masih randah; 6.000 matan 330.000 urang nang tatular di Afrika Selatan.
hypothesis: Namun, persentase XDR-TB dalam sabarataan kalompok urang nang ba'isi tuberkulosis tatap haja ta'andah; 6.000 matan total 330.000 urang nang ta'infeksi di setiap waktu tertentu di Afrika Selatan.

source: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
reference: Satelit nang barat kaduduanya labih dari 1.000 pon wan nang kelajuannya kira-kira 17.500 mil par jam, baranjahan 491 mil pas di atas bumi.
hypothesis: Satelit-satelit, nang badua-dua ba'berat labih dari 1.000 pon, wan ba'jalan sakitar 17.500 mil sa jam, tabrakan 491 mil di atas Bumi.

source: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
reference: Buhan panaliti manyambat bahwa latupan nang diulah imbah beranjahan tu ganal banar.
hypothesis: Ilmuwan bapandapat bahwa ledakan nang disababakan oleh tabrakan ngitu ganal.

source: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
reference: Buhannya masih mamparkira’akan sa’apa gonolnya tabrakan tadi wan jua kayapa kaina epeknya ka bumi.
hypothesis: bubuhannya masih mencoba manantuakan seberapa ganal tabrakan itu wan bagaimana bumi akan ta'aruf.

source: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
reference: Kantor Komando Strategis Amerika Serikat matan Departemen Pertahanan AS lagi mencari’i bakas raruntuhannya.
hypothesis: Komando Strategis Amerika Serikat dari Departemen Pertahanan Amerika Serikat melacak puing-puingnya.

source: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
reference: Hasil analisisnya kaina ditampaiakan akan di website umum.
hypothesis: Hasil analisis plot akan diposting di situs web umum.

source: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
reference: Saurang duktur nang bagawi di Rumah Sakit Anak Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania cagaran didakwa atas pambunuhan barat imbah mamanya kadapatan mati di dalam bagasi mubilnya hari Arba, jar pihak nang barwenang di Ohio.
hypothesis: Seorang dokter nang bagawi di Rumah Sakit Anak di Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania akan dituduh mambunuh setelah ibunya ditamuakan mati di bagasi mobilnya Rabu, ujar pihak berwenang di Ohio.

source: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
reference: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29 tahun, ditamuakan di Blue Ash, Ohio, daerah pinggiran 15 mil bagian utara Cincinnati haratan barabah di pinggir jalan baya mamakai baju kaus wan basempakan ja dalam kaadaan dipangaruhi ubat.
hypothesis: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, ditamuakan di Blue Ash, Ohio, pinggiran kota sakitar 15 mil utara Cincinnati, barbaring di tanah di pinggir jalan pakai baju T wan pakaian dalam dalam dalam keadaan nang manampaknya banyak obat.

source: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
reference: Inya manunjukakan wan patugas ka mubilnya nang tapisah sajauh 500 kaki.
hypothesis: Sidin manyuruh petugas ke Oldsmobile Intrigue nang hitam nang ada 500 kaki jauhnya.

source: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.
reference: Di sana, bubuhan patugas manamuakan mayat Saroja Balasubramanian, 53 tahun nang ditukupi pakai salimput babakas darah.

reference: Pas wayah pamulaan, partunjukannya baya manampilakan radiu internet nang sudah lawas barjalan, TogiNet Radiu, nang pokusnya ka pandiran.
hypothesis: Di awal-awal, acara ngini ditampaiakan di situs radio internet nang sudah lawas diulah TogiNet Radio, situs nang fokus pada radio pembicaraan.

source: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.
reference: Akhir 2015, TogiNet maulah AstroNet Radiu gasan stasiun cabang.
hypothesis: Pado akhir 2015, TogiNet manatapkan AstroNet Radio sabagai stasiun anak.

source: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
reference: Partunjukan ngini asalnya mangutamakan pangisi suara amatir, panduduk satampat sampai ka Texas Timur.
hypothesis: Acara ini awalnya baisi aktor suara amatir, lokal ka Texas Timur.

source: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
reference: Panjarahan maluas tarus balanjut sapanjang malam, Kadada patugas panagak hukum nang barada di jalan Bishkek.
hypothesis: Pambakaran nang luas dilaporkan tarus malam, karena aparat penegakan hukum kada hadir di jalanan Bishkek.

source: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
reference: Bishkek digambarakan ulih saurang pamarhati kaya masuk ka dalam kaadaan "anarkis", nang mana sagurumbulan urang bakaliaran di jalanan wan marampas barang-barang.
hypothesis: Bishkek digambarakan sebagai tenggelam ke dalam keadaan "anarki" oleh salah satu pengamat, karena geng-geng orang berkeliaran di jalanan dan merampok toko-toko barang-barang konsumen.

source: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
reference: Babarapa panduduk Bishkek manyalahakan pandemo matan salatan atas palanggaran hukum.
hypothesis: Babarapa panduduk Bishkek manyalahkan urang-urang nang manunjuk rasa matan selatan gasan kada parnah malakukan hukum.

source: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
reference: Afrika Salatan mangalahakan All Blacks (Islandia Baru) dalam partandingan rugby Tiga Nagara di Stadiun Royal Bafokeng, Rustenburg, Afrika Salatan.
hypothesis: Afrika Salatan sudah mananggulangi All Blacks (New Zealand) dalam patandingan Uni Rugbi Tri Nations di Stadion Royal Bafokeng di Rustenburg, Afrika Salatan.

source: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
reference: Hasil akhirnya kamanangan satu angka, 21-20, ma’akhiri kamanangan 15 kali baruntunnya All Blacks.
hypothesis: Skor akhir adalah kemenangan lawan satu poin, 21 lawan 20, manuntungakan 15 kemenangan beruntun All Blacks.

source: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
reference: Gasan Springboks, ngini tu ma’akhiri kakalahan lima kali baruntun buhannya.
hypothesis: gasan Springboks, itu mengakhiri lima pertandingan kalah beruntun.

source: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
reference: Pinal gasan All Blacks nang sudah mamanangakan piala dua minggu nang lalu.
hypothesis: Itu adalah pertandingan terakhir gasan All Blacks, nang sudah mandapatakan trofi dua minggu nang lalu.

source: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
reference: Partandingan pinal cagar batampat di Ellis Park di Johannesburg minggu kaina, pas Springboks malawan Australia.
hypothesis: Pertandingan akhir seri akan berlangsung di Ellis Park di Johannesburg minggu depan, pas Springboks lawan Australia.

source: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.
reference: Gampa bumi sadang mangguncang daerah barat Montana jam 10.08 Senin malam.
hypothesis: Gempa bumi nang moderat menggegarakan Montana barat pada jam 10:08 malam Senin.

source: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
reference: Kadada habar awal karusakan nang ditarima matan Lembaga Geologi Amerika Serikat (USGS) wan Pusat Informasi Gampa Bumi Nasiunal.
hypothesis: Kadada laporan langsung karusakan nang ditarima oleh United States Geological Survey (USGS) wan Pusat Informasi Gempa Bumi Nasional.

source: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
reference: Gampa bapusat sakitar 20 km (15 mil) utara-timur laut Dillon wan 65 km (40 mil) utara Butte.
hypothesis: Guncangan bumi ngitu bapusat kira-kira 20 km (15 mil) di utara-barat laut Dillon, wan kira-kira 65 km (40 mil) di selatan Butte.

source: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
reference: Jenis flu burung mamatikan gasan manusia, H5N1 sudah dipastiakan mandapati itik liar tatular mati hari Senin di tanah rawa parak Lyon di timur Prancis.
hypothesis: Stam flu burung nang mematikan gasan manusia, H5N1, sudah dikonfirmasi sudah manjangkiti bebek liar nang mati, nang ditamuakan pada Senin, di tanah rawa parak Lyon di timur Perancis.

source: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
reference: Prancis ngini jadi nagara ka tujuh di Parsatuan Eropa nang mangalami pirus ngini; diumpati wan Austria, Jerman, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Yunani wan Italia.
hypothesis: Prancis adalah negara ka-tujuh di Uni Eropa nang manjangkiti virus ini; imbah Austria, Jerman, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Yunani wan Italia.

source: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
reference: Dugaan kasus H5N1 di Kruasia wan Denmark masih balum kawa dipastiakan.
hypothesis: Kasus dugaan H5N1 di Kroasia wan Denmark masih kada dikonfirmasi.

source: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
reference: Chamber manuntut Tuhan gasan "kamatian nang maluas, kahancuran wan paneroran tarhadap jutaan panduduk Bumi."
hypothesis: Chambers manyudahi Tuhan gasan "membunuh, menghancurakan, dan mengganas jutaan penduduk bumi".

source: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
reference: Chamber nang saurang agnustik, mambantah bahuwa gugatannya "babarang" wan "siapa haja kawa manuntut siapa ja."
hypothesis: Chambers, seorang agnostik, berpendapat bahwa gugatannya "kurang penting" wan "siapa haja kawa menggugat siapa haja".

source: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
reference: Kisah nang ditampilakan di upera Prancis, ulih Camille Saint-Saens, marupakan seniman "nang hidupnya diatur ulih kacintaannya lawan ubat-ubatan wan Japang."
hypothesis: Kisah nang diungkapakan dalam opera Prancis, oleh Camille Saint-Saens, adalah tentang seorang seniman "nang hidupnya didikte oleh cinta lawan narkoba wan Jepang".

source: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
reference: Hasilnya, bubuhan pamain maisap ganja di atas panggung wan teaternya surang mambulihakan panuntunnya umpat bagabung.
hypothesis: Akibatnya, para pamain manikam ganja di panggung, wan teater itu sorang mandorong penonton gasan maniringi.

source: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
reference: Mantan Katua DPR Newt Gingrich, Gubarnur Texas Rick Perry, wan angguta wanita kungris Michel Bachmannpinis di paringkat ampat, lima, wan anam barurutan.
hypothesis: Mantan Ketua DPR, Newt Gingrich, gubernur Texas Rick Perry, wan anggota Kongres Michele Bachmann mancapai urutan kaampat, kalima, wan kaanam.

source: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
reference: Imbah hasilnya kaluar, Gingrich maambung Santorum, tapi ngalih bakata-kata gasan Romney, nang mangatas ngaranakan kampanye negatip nang disiarakan di Iowa malawan Gingrich.
hypothesis: Imbah hasil datang, Gingrich mamuji Santorum, tapi baisi kata-kata kasar gasan Romney, nang atas nama sidin iklan kampanye negatif disiarkan di Iowa lawan Gingrich.

source: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
reference: Perry manyambat inya cagaran "babulik ka Texas gasan manilai hasil partamuan malam ini, manantuakan apakah masih ada jalan kawa manarusakan", tapi imbah tu manyambat kalo inya bisa tatap lanjut wan basaing tanggal 21 Januari di Carolina Salatan.
hypothesis: Perry manyambat bahwa inya "akan bulik ka Texas gasan mamastiakan hasil kaukus malam ini, manantuakan apakah ada jalan ka hadapan gasan diriku dalam lomba ini", tapi imbah itu manyambat bahwa inya akan tatap dalam lomba wan bakumpati di pemilu utama Carolina Selatan 21 Januari.

source: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
reference: Bachmann, nang mamanangakan Poling Ames Straw di bulan Agustus mamutusakan ma’akhiri kampanyenya.
hypothesis: Bachmann, nang manang Ames Straw Poll pada bulan Agustus, mamutusakan gasan manutup kampanye sidin.

source: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
reference: Potograper dianjur ka Pusat Kesehatan Ronald Reagen UCLA nang mana imbah tu inya maninggal.
hypothesis: Fotografer itu dibawa ka Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, di mana sidin maninggal.

source: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
reference: Inya dihabarakan baumur sakitar 20 tahunan. Dalam sambatannya, Bieber manyambat, "Biar aku kada hadir atawa talibat langsung wan kajadian nitu, aku turut baduka cita gasan kaluarga kurban."
hypothesis: Sidin dilaporkan baumur di atas 20 tahun. Dalam sabuting pernyataan, Bieber manyambat "padahal ulun kada hadir atawa langsung terlibat lawan kecelakaan tragis ini, pikiran wan doa ulun ada lawan kaluarga korban".

source: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
reference: Badasarakan situs garamaan hiburan TMZ, inya mahantiakan kandaraannya di pinggir Sepulveda Boulevard wan mancuba maambil poto pulisi bamandak sabalum manyubarang jalan wan malanjutakan, maminta patugas Patroli jalan Raya California mahantiakan lalu lintas gasan maminta inya manyubarang lagi dua kali.
hypothesis: Situs berita hiburan TMZ mangarti'akan bahwa fotografer mandekakan kandaraan di sisi lain Sepulveda Boulevard wan bausaha maambil gambar dari parhentian polisi sabalum manjalani jalan wan manarusakan, manjurakan petugas polisi California Highway Patrol nang ma'ulah parhentian lalu lintas gasan manyuruh sidin baulang manjalani, dua kali.

source: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
reference: Manurut pulisi, pangandara nang maranjah si tukang poto pinanya kada mungkin kana tuntutan.
hypothesis: Manurut pulisi, supir kendaraan nang manimpa fotografer kada mungkin dihadapakan lawan tuduhan kriminal.

source: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
reference: Baya tasadia lapan belas madali haja sahari, babarapa nagara sudah kada kawa mandapatakan madali.
hypothesis: Dengan hanya 18 medali nang tersedia sahari, sejumlah negara gagal masuk ke podium medali.

source: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
reference: Diantaranya tamasuk Walanda, wan Anna Jochemsen tuntung diurutan kasambilan di kalas badiri babinian di Super-G samalam wan Finlandia wan Katja Saarinen tuntung di urutan kasapuluh di acara nang sama.
hypothesis: Di antaranya Belanda, lawan Anna Jochemsen nang manamatakan posisi kesembilan di kelas berdiri wanita di Super-G kemarin, wan Finlandia lawan Katja Saarinen nang manamatakan posisi kasampatan di acara nang sama.

source: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
reference: Mitchell Gourley matan Australia sudah tuntung di urutan kasawelas di kalumpuk lalakian badiri Super-G. Pasaingnya matan Ceko, Oldrich Jelinek tuntung di urutan kaanam belas di kalas lalakian baduduk Super-G.
hypothesis: Mitchell Gourley dari Australia mancapai urutan ka-11 di Super-G berdiri laki-laki. Saingannya dari Ceko, Oldrich Jelinek mancapai urutan ka-16 di Super-G duduk laki-laki.

source: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
reference: Arly Velasquez matan Miksiko tuntung di urutan kalima belas di kalumpuk lalakian duduk Super-G. Matan Islandia Baru, Adam Hall tuntung di urutan kasambilan di kalas lalakian badiri Super-G.
hypothesis: Arly Velasquez matan Meksiko mancapai urutan ka-15 di Super-G duduk gasan lakian. Adam Hall matan Selandia Baru mancapai urutan kasalapan di Super-G berdiri gasan lakian.

source: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
reference: Pamain ski tunanetra Polandia Maciej Krezel wan pamandunya Anna Ogarzynska tuntung di urutan katalung walas di Super-G. Jong Seork Park matan Korea Salatan sudah tuntung di urutan kadua puluh ampat di kalumpuk lalakian duduk Super-G.
hypothesis: Pembalap ski cacat penglihatan Polandia Maciej Krezel wan panuntun Anna Ogarzynska mancapai urutan ka-13 di Super-G. Jong Seork Park Korea Selatan mancapai urutan ka-24 di Super-G duduk.

source: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
reference: Pasukan panjaga pardamaian PBB, datang ka Haiti imbah gempa bumi 2010, ditiwasakan karana manyabarakan panyakit nang mana dimulai parak serobong tantara.
hypothesis: Pasukan penjaga perdamaian PBB, nang sampai di Haiti imbah gempa bumi tahun 2010, disalahakan gasan penyebaran penyakit nang dimulai parak kamp pasukan.

source: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
reference: Ujar parkara, limbah matan berserobong PBB itu kada tapi dibarasihi, ma’ulah bakteri masuk ka anak sungai Artibonite, salah satu sungai targanal di Haiti.
hypothesis: Manurut gugatan, limbah dari kamp PBB kada disuguhakan sacara saksama, manyababakan bakteri masuk ka sungai Artibonite, salah satu sungai terbesar di Haiti.

source: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
reference: Sabalum kadatangan tantara, nagara Haiti kada suah bamasalah nang bahubungan panyakit itu tumatan 1800an.
hypothesis: Sabalum datang pasukan, Haiti kada batamu masalah nang bahubungan lawan panyakit itu sejak tahun 1800-an.

source: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
reference: Institut Haiti sagan Keadilan wan Demokrasi babulik ka kapada panalitian indipinden nang manyatakan bahuwa batalyon pasukan panjaga pardamaian PBB dari Nepal kada sadar mambawa panyakit nitu ka Haiti.
hypothesis: Institut Haitian gasan Keadilan wan Demokrasi hudah ma'utihakan studi independen nang manunjukakan bahwa batalion penjaga damai PBB Nepal kada sadar mambawa penyakit ka Haiti.

source: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
reference: Danielle Lantagne, saurang ahli panyakit dari PBB, manyambat bahuwa panyakit ini manyabar karna pasukan panjaga pardamaian PBB.
hypothesis: Danielle Lantagne, ahli PBB tentang penyakit, manyambat bahwa wabah ini mungkin disababakan oleh pasukan penjaga perdamaian.

source: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
reference: Hamiton mamastiakan Rumah Sakit Universitas Howard manarima amun pasien ngitu dalam kondisi nang stabil.
hypothesis: Hamilton manakuni Rumah Sakit Universitas Howard manarima pasien dalam kondisi stabil.

source: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
reference: Pasien itu sudah ka Nigeria, nang mana babarapa kasus Ebola sudah tajadi.
hypothesis: Pasien itu pernah ke Nigeria, di mana beberapa kasus virus Ebola telah terjadi.

source: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
reference: Rumah Sakit sudah maumpati protokol gasan manguntrul infeksi, tamasuk mamisahakan pasien matan nang lain gasan malindati kamungkinan inpeksi matan nang lain.
hypothesis: Rumah sakit sudah maumpati protokol gasan pangendalian infeksi, tamasuk mamisahakan pasien matan nang lain gasan mencegah kemungkinan infeksi urang lain.

source: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
reference: Sabalum The Simpsons, Simon sudah bagawi di babarapa pamentasan di macam-macam posisi.
hypothesis: Sabalum The Simpsons Simon bagawi di babarapa acara di bamacam posisi.

source: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
reference: Salawas tahun 1980 inya bagawi di pamentasan nang kaya Taxi, Cheers, wan The Tracy Ullman Show.
hypothesis: Salawas 1980-an sidin bagawi di acara-acara nang kaya Taxi, Cheers, wan The Tracy Ullman Show.

source: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
reference: Di tahun 1989 inya mambantui maulah The Simpsons wan Brooks wan Groening, lawan jua diparcayai gasan marekrut tim panulis pamentasan nang pamulaan.
hypothesis: Tahun 1989 inya mambantu maulah The Simpsons lawan Brooks wan Groening, wan bertanggung jawab gasan mandapatakan tim panulis pertama acara.

source: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
reference: Biar imbah maninggalakan pamentasan di tahun 1993, inya tatap manjadi produser eksekutif, wan tatap manarima puluhan juta dolar saban musim sabagai royalti.
hypothesis: Walaupun maninggal'akan acara itu pas tahun 1993, sidin manjaga'akan gelar produser eksekutif, wan tarus manarima puluhan juta dolar saban musim sabagai royalti.

source: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.
reference: Hanyar haja kantor habar Cina Xinhua mahabarakan sabuah pasawat sudah dibajak.
hypothesis: Sabalumnya, agensi berita Cina Xinhua malaporakan sabuah pesawat nang akan dibajak.

source: Later reports then stated the plane received a bomb threat and was diverted back to Afghanistan, landing in Kandahar.
reference: Habar pandudian memadahi pasawat ngitu mandapat ancaman bom wan disimpangakan babulik ka Afganistan, mandarat di Kandahar.
hypothesis: Laporan imbahnya manulisakan bahwa pesawat itu manarima ancaman bom wan diarahakan pulang ka Afghanistan, manunduk di Kandahar.

source: The early reports say the plane was diverted back to Afghanistan after being denied an emergency landing in Ürümqi.
reference: Habar awal memadahakan pasawat disimpangakan babulik ka Afganistan imbah ditulakakan pandaratan darurat di Ürümqi.
hypothesis: Laporan awal manunjukakan bahwa pesawat itu dibalikakan ka Afghanistan imbah dihalangakan manuruniakan darurat di Ürümqi.

source: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
reference: Kacalakaan udara sudah rancak di Iran, nang mana baisi armada tuha nang kada tarawat baik gasan pamarintah wan gasan operasi militer.
hypothesis: Kacilakaan udara rancak di Iran, nang baisi armada nang sudah tuha wan kada baik dijaga baik gasan operasi sipil maupun militer.

source: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.
reference: Sanksi internasional nang maksudnya pasawat hanyar kada kawa ditukari.
hypothesis: Sanksi internasional bararti pesawat hanyar kada kawa dibeli.

source: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
reference: Hanyar minggu ngini, kacalakaan saurang pulisi helikupter maakibatakan tiga ikung urang maninggal wan tiga ikung labih luka-luka.
hypothesis: Awal minggu ini, tabrakan helikopter polisi mambunuh talu urang wan manyakiti talu urang lainnya.

source: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
reference: Bulan samalam Iran malihat bancana angin paling buruk dalam babarapa tahun pas sabuah pasawat manuju Armenia gugur, manewasakan 168 di pasawat.
hypothesis: Bulan lalu Iran manamuakan musibah udara terburuknya dalam babarapa tahun, pas sabuah pesawat panumpang nang baarah ka Armenia tahancur, mambunuh 168 urang di atasnya.

source: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
reference: Di bulan nang sama malihat pasawat lain maliwati jalur pasawat di Mashald lalu maranjah ka dinding, manewasakan tujuh belas urang.
hypothesis: Bulan nang sama malihat pesawat lain manarik landasan pacu di Mashhad wan manimpa dinding, mambunuh tujuh belas urang.

source: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
reference: Aerosmith mambatalakan sisa konser dalam tur buhannya.
hypothesis: Aerosmith sudah membatalkan konser-konser sisa tur mereka.

source: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
reference: Band rok ngitu dijadwalakan ka Amerika Serikat wan Kanada sampai 16 September.
hypothesis: Band rock itu dijadwalakan gasan tur di Amerika Serikat wan Kanada sampai 16 September.

source: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
reference: Buhannya sudah mambatalakan tur ngitu limbah panyanyi utama Steven Tyler mandapat cidira limbah gugur matan panggung pas partunjukan pas 5 Agustus.
hypothesis: Bubuhannya manunggalakan tur imbah penyanyi utama Steven Tyler luka imbah sidin gugur di panggung pas tampil tanggal 5 Agustus.

source: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
reference: Murray kahilangan set partamanya dalam babah tambahan imbah kaduduanya saling mampartahanakan satiap serpis di satiap set.
hypothesis: Murray kalah set partama dalam break tie imbah kaduanya lakian manjaga satiap servis di set.

source: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.
reference: Del Potro baisi kauntungan awal di set kadua, tapi ngini maharusakan babak tambahan imbah mancapai 6-6.
hypothesis: Del Potro baisi kaunggulan awal di set kadua, tapi ngini jua mamarluakan break talipas imbah mancapai 6-6.

source: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
reference: Potro sawat manarima pangubatan di bahunya wayah ini tapi kawa babulik ka parmainan.
hypothesis: Potro manarima parlakuan ka bahu di titik ngini tapi berhasil babulik ka pamainan.

source: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
reference: Program ngitu dimulai jam 8.30 p.m. waktu satampat (15.00 UTC).
hypothesis: Program dimulai pas jam 8:30 sore waktu lokal (15.00 UTC).

source: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
reference: Wayah ikam manilpon urang nang ribuan mil jauhnya, ikam mamakai satelit.
hypothesis: Amun Pian manghubungakan urang nang bajarak ribuan mil, Pian mangguna'akan satelit.

source: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
reference: Satelit di luar angkasa mandapat panggilan imbah tu mamantulakan ka bawah, sacara capat.
hypothesis: Satelit di angkasa tarima pangatahuan wan imbahtu mancarminakan pangatahuan ka bawah, hampir langsung.

source: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
reference: Satelit dikirim ka luar angkasa mamakai roket. Ilmuwan mamakai teleskop di luar angkasa sabab atmosfer Bumi maubah cahaya wan panjanakan kita.
hypothesis: Satelit itu dikirim ke ruang angkasa oleh roket. ilmuwan memakai teleskop di ruang angkasa karena atmosfer bumi melemahkan sebagian cahaya dan pandangan kita.

source: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
reference: Ngini mamakai roket raksasa malabihi 100 kaki tingginya gasan maandak satelit atawa teleskop ka luar angkasa.
hypothesis: Dibutuhakan roket ganal nang labih matan 100 kaki tinggi gasan manimbulakan satelit atawa teleskop ka ruang angkasa.

source: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
reference: Roda sudah maubah dunia sacara mankjubakan. Hal paling penting nang sudah digawi roda gasan kita yato mambari kita banyak kamudahan wan angkutan nang labih laju.
hypothesis: Garis sudah maubah dunia dalam cara nang ganal. Hal nang paling ganal nang sudah dilakukan roda gasan kita adalah kami dibari transportasi nang labih mudah dan lebih cepat.

source: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
reference: Roda sudah mambawakan kita kureta, mutur, wan banyak angkutan nang lain.
hypothesis: Itu sudah mandapatakan kita kereta api, mobil, wan banyak alat transportasi lainnya.

source: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
reference: Di bawah buhannya ada kucing nang ukuran sadang nang mamakan mangsa baukuran sadang matan kalinci sampai ka kancil wan rusa.
hypothesis: Di bawahnya ada kucing nang labih ganal nang makan mangsa ganal mulai dari kelinci sampai antilop wan rusa.

source: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
reference: Akhirnya, ada banyak kucing halus (tamasuk kucing inguan balapas) nang mamakan jauh labih baragam mangsa halus nang kaya sarangga, binatang pangarat, kadal, wan burung.
hypothesis: Akhirnya, ada banyak kucing halus (tamasuk kucing peliharaan nang kada beisi tali) nang makan mangangkut nang jauh labih banyak nang kaya serangga, tikus, kadal, wan burung.

source: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
reference: Rahasia kabarhasilannya yato konsep lekung, sabuting gawian nang istimiwa nang kucing baisi ngitu matan basaing wan nang lain.
hypothesis: Rahasia gasan kasuksesan buhannya adalah konsep niche, tugas khusus nang dimiliki setiap kucing nang mehalangi buhannya gasan bersaing lawan nang lain.

source: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
reference: Singa ngitu kucing nang paling basosial, badiam di kalumpuk ganal nang disambat kawanan.
hypothesis: Singa adalah kucing nang paling sosial, hidup dalam kelompok ganal nang disambat pride.

source: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
reference: Kawanan tabantuk matan sabuting sampai talu targantung jantan ganal, lawan sampai talu puluh batina wan anak-anaknya.
hypothesis: Kakanakan tadiri matan satu sampai talu anak lakian nang bahubungan, lawan sampai tiga puluh anak binian wan anak-anak.

source: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
reference: Nang batina rajin tu parak saikung lawan saikung, manjadi kaluarga ganal matan kaka-ading wan anak babini.
hypothesis: Nang binian biasanya bahubungan erat satu lawan lain, jadi kaluarga ganal nang terdiri dari ading-adik wan anak-anak.

source: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
reference: Kawanan singa baaksi nangkaya kawanan sarigala atawa hadupan, binatang nang handak sama kaya singa (tapi lain kucing) dalam hal batingkah, wan juwa mamatikan banar ka mangsanya.
hypothesis: Singa prida bagawi mirip lawan kawanan serigala atawa anjing, binatang nang mirip lawan singa (tapi kada kucing ganal lainnya) dalam parilaku, wan jua sangat mematikan gasan mangangkutnya.

source: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
reference: Saurang atlit nang saraba bisa, macan kawa banaik-naik (maski kada lihai), bakunyung, malacung jarak jauh wan manjuhut lima kali labih kuat daripada kakuatan manusia.
hypothesis: Seurang atlet nang baik, harimau kawa manjat (walaupun kada baik), balari, manarik jarak nang ganal wan manarik lawan lima kali kakuatan manusia nang kuat.

source: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
reference: Macan ngitu ada di kalumpuk nang sama (Gen Panthera) nang kaya singa, macan tutul, wan jaguar. Ampat kucing ngini haja nang kawa maraung.
hypothesis: Harimau adalah dalam kalompok nang sama (Genus Panthera) lawan singa, macan, wan jaguar. Ampat kucing ngini haja nang kawa manggarum.

source: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
reference: Raungan macan kada sapanuh kaya ampun singa, tapi labih nang kaya kalimat garaman, kuriakan kata-kata.
hypothesis: Harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum harum

source: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
reference: Ocelot katuju makan binatang halus. Inya cagar manangkap warik, ular, binatang pangarat, wan burung kalo inya kawa. Handak sabarataan binatang nang Ocelot buru ngitu jauh labih halus daripada dirinya.
hypothesis: Ocelot katuju makan binatang halus. inya akan manangkap monyet, ular, tikus wan burung amun kawa. hampir sabarataan binatang nang diburu ocelot jauh labih halus daripada nang sebenarnya.

source: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
reference: Buhan ilmuwan bapikir kalo ocelot maumpati wan mandapati binatang gasan dimakan (dimangsa) malalui bau, manciumi di mana buhannya barada di atas tanah.
hypothesis: Buhan ilmuwan bapikir bahwa ocelot maumpati wan manamuakan binatang gasan dimakan (manjala) lawan baunya, maimbut di mana buhannya sudah ada di tanah.

source: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
reference: Inya kawa malihat dengan jalas dalam kadap lawan panglihatan malam, wan bagarak diam-diam, juwa. Ocelots mamburu mangsanya pakai cara basambunyi di sakitaran imbah tu marungkau mangsanya.
hypothesis: Ocelot kawa malihat banar di gelap lawan penglihatan malam, wan bergerak banar kada dilacak jua. Ocelot memburu mangguna'akan buhannya lawan malapukan lawan lingkungan buhannya lalu manambakan buhannya.

source: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
reference: Pas kalumpuk halus makhluk hidup (dalam populasi halus) tapisah matan pupulasi utamanya wadahnya baasal (misalnya inya pindah ka wilayah pagunungan atawa sungai, atawa kalau inya pindah ka pulau hanyar jadi inya ngalih handak babulik) inya cagar rancak marasa ada wadah nang balain matan nang buhannya dahulu.
hypothesis: Pas kalompok halus makhluk hidup (populasi halus) dipisahakan dari populasi utama nang asalnya (kaya amun buhannya pindah ke atas pegunungan atawa sungai, atawa amun buhannya pindah ke pulau hanyar supaya buhannya kada kawa baubah pulang) buhannya rancak manamuakan diri buhannya dalam lingkungan nang balain lawan nang diadaakan sebelumnya.

source: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
reference: Lingkungan nang hanyar ngini baisi sumber nang balain wan pasaing nang balain, jadi populasi hanyar cagar parlu sifat nang balain atawa manyasuaiakan manjadi pasaing labih kuat daripada apa nang buhannya parlu sabalumnya.
hypothesis: Lingkungan hanyar ini baisi sumber daya nang balain wan pesaing nang balain, jadi populasi hanyar ini mamarluakan fitur atawa adaptasi nang balain gasan manjadi pesaing nang kuat daripada apa nang diparluakan sabalumnya.

source: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
reference: Populasi awal balum barubah sama sakali, ngitu masih parlu panyasuaian nang sama kaya sabalumnya.
hypothesis: Populasi asli kada baubah sama sekali, buhannya masih parlu adaptasi nang sama kaya bahari.

source: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
reference: Waktu balalu, populasi hanyar mulai manyasuaiakan ka lingkungan hanyarnya, buhannya mulai kurang mehatiakan wan kurang katuju wan populasi nang lain.
hypothesis: Seiring waktu, seiring populasi hanyar mulai beradaptasi lawan lingkungan hanyar, buhannya mulai kurang mirip lawan populasi lainnya.

source: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
reference: Padahal lah, ribuan atawa jutaan tahun nang lalu, dua populasi cagar talihat balain banar nang mana buhannya kada kawa disambat matan spesies nang sama.
hypothesis: Akhirnya, imbah ribuan atawa bahkan jutaan tahun, dua populasi ngitu akan kelihatan begitu balain sehingga kada kawa disambat spesies nang sama.

source: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
reference: Kami manyambatnya ngini proses manspesialkan, nang cuma baarti mambantuk spesies hanyar. Panspesialan ialah konsekuensi nang kada kawa diabaiakan wan bagian nang penting banar matan evolusi.
hypothesis: Kami manyambat proses ngini spesiasi, nang artinya adalah pambentukan spesies hanyar. Spesiasi adalah akibat nang kada kawa dihindari wan bagian nang penting banar dalam evolusi.

source: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
reference: Tanaman maulah oksigen nang dihiyut manusia, wan buhannya maambil karbondioksida nang dihambusakan manusia (ngitu pang, bahinak).
hypothesis: Tumbuhan maulah oksigen nang dihirup manusia, wan maambil karbon dioksida nang dihirup manusia (yaitu, dihirup kaluar).

source: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
reference: Tanaman maulah makanannya surang matan matahari malalui fotosintesis. Buhannya juwa manyadiakan kanaungan.
hypothesis: Tumbuhan maulah makanan matan matahari malalui fotosintesis.

source: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
reference: Kami maulah rumah kami pakai tanaman wan maulah baju pakai tanaman. Kabanyakan makanan nang kami makan ngitu tanaman-tanaman. Kadeda tanaman, binatang-binatang kada kawa batahan.
hypothesis: Kita maulah rumah kita dari tumbuhan wan maulah baju dari tumbuhan. Kabanyakan makanan nang kita makan adalah tumbuhan. Tanpa tumbuhan, satua kada kawa hidup.

source: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
reference: Mosasaurus marupakan pamangsa puncak di masanya, jadi inya kada takut apa haja, kacuali mosasaurus lainnya.
hypothesis: Mosasaurus adalah pemangsa puncak pada masanya, jadi inya kada takutan apa-apa, kecuali mosasaurus lainnya.

source: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
reference: Rahangnya nang panjang bahambur wan labih matan 70 gigi nang landap nang kaya silit, diumpati wan saparangkat tambahan di langit-langit muntungnya, nang baarti bahuwa kadada jalan kaluar gasan apa haja nang malalui jalannya.
hypothesis: Gula panjangnya banyak nang kaya 70 gigi tajam, lawan satu lagi di atap muntungnya, artinya kada ada nang bisa malapas apa pun nang tajalani jalannya.

source: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
reference: Kita kada tahu pasti, tagal natu mungkin baisi ilat nang bacabang. Makanannya tamasuk kura-kura, iwak ganal, mosasaurus nang lain, wan natu bahkan bisa jadi kanibal.
hypothesis: Kita kada yakin, tapi mungkin inya baisi lidah nang bercabang. Makanan sidin tamasuk kura-kura, iwak ganal, mosasaurus lainnya, wan mungkin jua kanibal.

source: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
reference: Natu jua manyarang apa haja nang masuk ka banyu, bahkan dinusaurus ganal nang kaya T. rex kada bakal sabanding lawan natu.
hypothesis: Itu jua manyarang apa haja nang masuk ka dalam banyu; bahkan dinosaurus raksasa nang kaya T. rex kada kawa lawan.

source: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
reference: Biar kabanyakan makanannya talihat sama gasan kita, buhan Rumawi gin baisi hidangan aneh atawa kada biasa, tamasuk babi hutan, burung marak, ular, wan sajanis binatang pangarat di sambat durmus
hypothesis: Banyak makanan urang Roma nang kita tahu, tapi ada jua makanan nang aneh atawa kada biasa, tamasuk babi liar, burung merak, siput, wan jenis tikus nang disambat dormouse

source: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
reference: Parbidaan lainnya pas urang miskin wan binian mamakan makanannya sambil duduk di kursi, lakian sugih katuju ma’adakan jamuan ba-sama-sama nang mana buhannya barabah di higa makanannya sambil mamakan makanan buhannnya.
hypothesis: Parbidaan lain adalah amun urang miskin wan bibinian makan sambil duduk di kursi, urang kaya katuju baisi pesta basamaan di mana buhannya akan duduk di sisi buhannya sambil makan.

source: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
reference: Makanan Rumawi bahari kada mamasukakan makanan nang barasal matan Eropa matan Amerika atawa matan Asia di abad dudi-dudi.
hypothesis: Makan Romawi kuno kada kawa maliputi makanan nang datang ka Eropa dari Amerika atawa dari Asia di abad-abad imbahnya.

source: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
reference: Umpamanya, buhannya kada baisian jagung, atawa tumat, atawa kantang, atawa cuklat, wan kadada Rumawi bahari nang suah marasai daging kalkun.
hypothesis: Contohnya, buhannya kada baisi jagung, atawa tomato, atawa kentang, atawa kakao, wan kada ada urang Romawi kuno nang pernah ma-rasakan kalkun.

source: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
reference: Buhan Babilonia maulahakan masing-masing dewanya sabuah kuil nang diparcaya sabagai rumah dewa ngitu.
hypothesis: Urang-urang Babilonia mambangun tiap-tiap dewa-dewa mereka sabuah kuil utama nang dianggap sebagai rumah dewa.

source: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
reference: Urang-urang mambawa sasaji gasan dewa-dewa ngitu lalu pandita maurusi kabutuhan dewa-dewa ngitu lawan maadaakan upacara-upacara wan pestipal-pastipal.
hypothesis: Urang akan mambawa kurban gasan dewa-dewa wan imam-imam akan mencoba gasan memenuhi kebutuhan dewa-dewa melalui upacara wan festival.

source: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
reference: Satiap kuil baisi halaman kuil nang tabuka wan sabuting wadah karamat di dalam nang pandita haja kawa masuk.
hypothesis: Masing-masing kuil baisi halaman kuil nang tabuka wan wadah suci nang di dalam nang hanya imam nang kawa masuk.

source: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
reference: Takananya piramida husus babantuk manara, dingarani ziggurat, diulah gasan jadi bagian kuil.
hypothesis: Kadang-kadang menara nang berbentuk piramida khusus, nang disambat ziggurats, dibangun gasan menjadi bagian dari kuil.

source: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
reference: Bagian atas manara ngitu wadah suci gasan si dewa.
hypothesis: Puncak manara tu adalah tempat suci khusus gasan dewa.

source: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
reference: Iklim hangat di Timur Tangah, rumah kada tapi penting.
hypothesis: Di iklim hangat Timur Tengah, rumah kada penting banar.

source: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
reference: Kabanyakan kahidupan kaluarga Ibrani balangsung di udara tabuka.
hypothesis: Kabanyakan kahidupan kaluarga Ibrani tu tajadi di udara.

source: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
reference: Buhan binian bamasak di halaman; tuku-tuku buka mahadap langsung ka jalan. Batu dipakai gasan maulah rumah-rumah.
hypothesis: Wanita-wanita nang maulah masakan di halaman; toko-toko hanya wadah nang tabuka nang malihat jalan. Batu dipakai gasan mambangun rumah.
